  • Flathead (Bitterroot Salish)↗Specific constituent people within a present confederated government
    Connection & source
    Specific constituent people within a present confederated government

    CSKT identifies Bitterroot Salish as one of its three distinct constituent nations, discusses their Montana reservation connection, and publishes its Pablo, Montana government address. Its explanation says Flathead is associated with the reservation name and favors the peoples' specific identities. The directory's older Flathead access label therefore points here without treating all CSKT peoples as Bitterroot Salish.

    Continuing confederated community connection; public account inspected October 21, 2026. Reviewed 2026-10-21.

    Read the supporting source ↗ · Supporting source 1 ↗

These are starting lists, not a complete census. Modern borders help you navigate; they are not Indigenous homeland boundaries. A connection may be historical or present-day and does not imply presence throughout a region. Directory names can overlap; the profiles explain their relationships.
